question: what is crompton awareness in north zone
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT respondent_id) AS total FROM v_respondents r WHERE LOWER(r.zone_name)='north'), brand_stages AS (SELECT v.brand_name, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(v.stage)='tom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tom_n, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(v.stage) IN ('tom','spont') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS spont_n, COUNT(v.respondent_id) AS aided_n FROM v_brand_awareness v JOIN v_respondents r ON v.respondent_id=r.respondent_id WHERE LOWER(r.zone_name)='north' AND LOWER(v.brand_name)='crompton' GROUP BY v.brand_name) SELECT brand_name, ROUND(tom_n*100.0/(SELECT total FROM base),1) AS tom_pct, ROUND(spont_n*100.0/(SELECT total FROM base),1) AS spont_pct, ROUND(aided_n*100.0/(SELECT total FROM base),1) AS aided_pct, tom_n, spont_n, aided_n, (SELECT total FROM base) AS base_respondents FROM brand_stages

question: top of mind awareness for all brands nationally
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT respondent_id) AS total FROM v_respondents) SELECT brand_name, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT respondent_id)*100.0/(SELECT total FROM base),1) AS tom_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT respondent_id) AS tom_count FROM v_brand_awareness WHERE LOWER(stage)='tom' GROUP BY brand_name ORDER BY tom_pct DESC LIMIT 15

question: crompton awareness by zone breakdown
sql: WITH zone_base AS (SELECT r.zone_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.respondent_id) AS total FROM v_respondents r GROUP BY r.zone_name), brand_stages AS (SELECT r.zone_name, v.brand_name, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(v.stage)='tom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tom_n, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(v.stage) IN ('tom','spont') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS spont_n, COUNT(v.respondent_id) AS aided_n FROM v_brand_awareness v JOIN v_respondents r ON v.respondent_id=r.respondent_id WHERE LOWER(v.brand_name)='crompton' GROUP BY r.zone_name, v.brand_name) SELECT bs.zone_name, bs.brand_name, ROUND(tom_n*100.0/zb.total,1) AS tom_pct, ROUND(spont_n*100.0/zb.total,1) AS spont_pct, ROUND(aided_n*100.0/zb.total,1) AS aided_pct FROM brand_stages bs JOIN zone_base zb ON bs.zone_name=zb.zone_name ORDER BY bs.zone_name

question: what is crompton nps score
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(nps_category)='promoter' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(nps_category)='detractor' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),1) as nps_score, COUNT(*) as total_raters, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(nps_category)='promoter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(nps_category)='detractor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as detractors, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(nps_category)='passive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passives FROM v_brand_nps WHERE LOWER(brand_name)='crompton'

question: nps rankings for all brands

question: crompton aided awareness in south zone among female respondents
